interface.longDescription:
A growing collection of skills for coding agents.

thai-natural-writing: reviews and rewrites Thai text (often AI-generated) so it reads like a person wrote it. Picks wording by audience, keeps technical terms Thai practitioners already say in English (Architecture, Backend, API, Deploy), cuts padded verbs and AI-style phrasing, and never changes code, names, URLs, or meaning.
defaultPrompt: Use $thai-natural-writing to make this Thai sound natural: (Thai text)
